name: @anvilkit/agent-knowledge
description: Knowledge service of the AnvilKit Agent platform (DD-07, DD-09, delivery.md P14): in this build the owner of anvilkit.knowledge.v1.BackgroundTaskService over the durable background_requests tables, the transactional outbox written on the same pg client transaction as every domain fact (the physical schema of the pinned watermill-sql adapter, forwarded by the Go sidecar under forwarder/), the lease sweeper, cancellation and the immutable configuration generations. Since P15/P16 also sources, ingestion, the Index Builder over Qdrant, snapshots and hybrid retrieval; MemoryFact arrives with P17.
